# Binmucker

> The personal internet home base of Conor Chepenik. Free tools, daily writing, Bitcoin experiments, and useful software for a more sovereign life.

For full details see: https://binmucker.com

## Quick Summary

Binmucker.com is the personal site of Conor Chepenik featuring:
- Free AI-powered local business SEO audit (local search, reviews, content, technical SEO, and AI readiness)
- Free breathing exercise app (5 guided patterns for focus, calm, sleep, and recovery)
- Browser-based Space Invaders game (5 levels, bosses, power-ups, endless mode)
- Bitcoin and Lightning tools (Sound Money Mortgage, Saylorscope, Fortune Sats, Bitcoin Coloring Book)
- Open-source projects (RyRacer, GuitarGui, Handwritten Letters)
- Daily writing on Medium and long-form essays on the Binmucker blog
- Curated stack of tools and services with clear referral disclosures

## Main Categories

- **Build** — Free SEO audit, experiments, and useful software
- **Bitcoin** — Lightning integrations, educational tools, and sound money calculators
- **Writing** — Daily notes on Medium and longer essays on the blog
- **Play** — Breathe Better, Space Invaders, RyRacer, GuitarGui
- **Stack** — Services and products I actually use, with honest disclosure
- **Connect** — Social profiles, merch, and support options
